$comment: Server calls each page makes in one idle, visible minute with a healthy live channel (tests/idle-request-budget.test.tsx). A call not listed is allowed 0. Budgets only go down: the test fails when a page goes over, and when it measures at or below half a budget, so lower the number (remove the entry at 0).

agents.pollDevices.why: a device online through the gateway has no write when it goes offline, so the list keeps the shared 60 s live fallback while one is; every other device change is pushed (device_list)
